learning.title: Set a poll interval for self-hosted Inngest behind a redeploying API
learning.trigger: Self-hosted inngest start runs next to an API that is redeployed or restarted independently, for example on a PaaS.
learning.rule: inngest start --poll-interval defaults to 0, which means the server does not re-poll the SDK URL after the first sync attempt. Set INNGEST_POLL_INTERVAL (the QA start script uses 60) so a redeployed API is picked up without restarting Inngest. Also gate Inngest on the API readiness (BAKERY_WAIT_FOR_READY) so the first sync finds it.

Keep INNGEST_TICK at 1000 and INNGEST_POSTGRES_MAX_OPEN_CONNS at 20 on small plans. The local proof saw idle CPU ticks 25 versus 35 over 30 seconds for tick 1000 versus 150, and Postgres sessions drop from 5 to 1 with a lower connection cap.

verification.requirement: Check the Inngest GraphQL apps list shows the Bakery app with functions and no sync error after an API redeploy within the poll interval.

learning.boundary: The default of 0 is from inngest start --help on v1.44.0. Re-sync after an API restart was not measured in the local proof, only the first sync; do not claim it until a live run shows it.
